(e)
```{r}
cat("\n=== (e) 各變數之 FE vs RE t 檢定 ===\n")

vars_e <- c("small", "aide", "tchexper", "white_asian", "freelunch")

hausman_t_test <- function(fe_model, re_model, variables) {
  
  b_fe <- coef(fe_model)[variables]
  b_re <- coef(re_model)[variables]
  
  v_fe <- diag(vcov(fe_model))[variables]
  v_re <- diag(vcov(re_model))[variables]
  
  var_diff <- v_fe - v_re
  
  se_diff <- ifelse(var_diff > 0, sqrt(var_diff), NA)
  t_stat <- (b_fe - b_re) / se_diff
  p_value <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(t_stat)))
  
  result <- data.frame(
    Variable = variables,
    Beta_FE = as.numeric(b_fe),
    Beta_RE = as.numeric(b_re),
    Difference = as.numeric(b_fe - b_re),
    Var_FE_minus_Var_RE = as.numeric(var_diff),
    t_stat = as.numeric(t_stat),
    p_value = as.numeric(p_value)
  )
  
  return(result)
}

hausman_t_summary <- hausman_t_test(model_b, model_d, vars_e)

hausman_t_summary_print <- hausman_t_summary

num_cols <- sapply(hausman_t_summary_print, is.numeric)
hausman_t_summary_print[num_cols] <- lapply(
  hausman_t_summary_print[num_cols],
  round,
  5
)

print(hausman_t_summary_print)


cat("\n=== (e) 補充：將同樣檢定套用在 BOY ===\n")

boy_test <- hausman_t_test(model_b, model_d, "boy")
boy_test_print <- boy_test

num_cols <- sapply(boy_test_print, is.numeric)
boy_test_print[num_cols] <- lapply(
  boy_test_print[num_cols],
  round,
  5
)

print(boy_test_print)


cat("\n=== (e) 補充：phtest 聯合檢定，若矩陣奇異可忽略 ===\n")

hausman_joint <- tryCatch(
  phtest(model_b, model_d),
  error = function(e) e
)

print(hausman_joint)
```
(f)
```{r}
cat("\n=== (f) Mundlak Test ===\n")

# 建立 school averages
star$mean_small       <- ave(star$small,       star$schid, FUN = mean)
star$mean_aide        <- ave(star$aide,        star$schid, FUN = mean)
star$mean_tchexper    <- ave(star$tchexper,    star$schid, FUN = mean)
star$mean_boy         <- ave(star$boy,         star$schid, FUN = mean)
star$mean_white_asian <- ave(star$white_asian, star$schid, FUN = mean)
star$mean_freelunch   <- ave(star$freelunch,   star$schid, FUN = mean)

mundlak_fml <- readscore ~ small + aide + tchexper + boy + white_asian + freelunch +
  mean_small + mean_aide + mean_tchexper +
  mean_boy + mean_white_asian + mean_freelunch

# Regression-based Mundlak model
mundlak <- lm(mundlak_fml, data = star)

# 使用 school-clustered robust standard errors
robust_vcov <- vcovCL(mundlak, cluster = ~ schid)

cat("\n--- Mundlak 迴歸估計結果，使用 school-clustered robust SE ---\n")
print(coeftest(mundlak, vcov = robust_vcov))


cat("\n=== (f) Mundlak Wald Test ===\n")

mundlak_wald <- linearHypothesis(
  mundlak,
  c(
    "mean_small = 0",
    "mean_aide = 0",
    "mean_tchexper = 0",
    "mean_boy = 0",
    "mean_white_asian = 0",
    "mean_freelunch = 0"
  ),
  vcov = robust_vcov
)

print(mundlak_wald)
```
